summary: This guide outlines optimal summoning strategies and top team compositions for progression in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Content creators Fastidious and OddOneGaming explain how players should transition from building 1-2 core teams in early game to 6 teams for late-season Continental Challenges. The five primary meta schools recommended to focus on are Aura, Ice Blast, Dauntless, Toxin, and Burn. Key summoning advice emphasizes saving at least 300 Heliolite Dice to guarantee desired Premium Legendaries via Option Summons or Wish/Echo banners, while avoiding low-guarantee seasonal banners.

teams.note: Core 3-man Aura shell offering extreme durability and top single-target and AoE DPS.
Premier Toxin team providing massive AoE poison damage and resistance reduction.
High-octane Dauntless core delivering immense single-target attack speed and penetration.
High-damage Burn comp utilizing Durem as the primary non-premium Legendary carry.

meta_changes: Aura, Toxin, Burn, Ice Blast, and Dauntless represent the top 5 damage schools in the meta.
Wild and Frost damage schools have experienced powercreep in late-game progression compared to newer schools.
tips: Focus on building 1-2 strong teams for Phase 1 dungeons and Temporal Vortex before expanding to 6 teams for late-season Continental Challenges.
Always save at least 300 Heliolite Dice before pulling on Option Summons or Wish/Echo banners to guarantee your target Legendary hero.
Free-to-play players earn approximately 900 Heliolite Dice per season, enough to hit the 300-pity milestone on 3 key banners.
Avoid pulling on 800-pity seasonal targeted support banners unless you are a heavy spender.
